Published research edition

Open data.
Visible evidence.

Inspect what is supported, what is inherited, and what still needs review. Research counts come from the versioned evidence graph; earlier public identifiers are labeled separately.

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Progress toward publication

Legacy inclusion audits
39 / 39
Qualifying suppliers
73 / 60
Distinct reviewed papers
225 / 150
Dataset families
85 / 60
Benchmark families
87 / 20
Frozen core disposition
94% / 90%

2548 approved assertions · 195 candidate assertions · 39 historical descriptions.

The frozen eligible core and two separate 200-record quality audits must also pass. The reference audit requires 98% precision and 95% recall, with no critical false attribution. The screening audit must recover at least 190 records and reach 90% recall in each major stratum.

The calculated publication requirements pass. Edition publication still follows the recorded release process.
